title: From Calgary Explore Moraine Lake Lake Louise and end in Banff
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the best of the Canadian Rockies on this one-way tour from Calgary to Lake Louise and Moraine Lake, ending in the charming mountain town of Banff. Marvel at turquoise lakes, soaring peaks, and scenic viewpoints as we guide you through two of Canada's most iconic destinations. After exploring the stunning lakes, enjoy free time in Banff to shop, dine, or stroll at your own pace. It's the perfect mix of sightseeing and freedom to explore on your own!
